parts.name: Transmission (6-speed)
parts.description: A six-speed manual constant-mesh gearbox inside the crankcase.
parts.function: Selects the ratio between engine speed and rear-wheel speed. Low gears multiply torque to pull away; high gears let the engine turn slowly at cruising speed.

parts.name: Mainshaft
parts.description: The transmission input shaft, driven by the clutch.
parts.function: Carries engine torque into the gear pairs.
parts.verificationNote: This is a generic gearbox part. The Honda name, gear layout and part numbers are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Countershaft
parts.description: The transmission output shaft. The front (drive) sprocket mounts on its end.
parts.function: Delivers the selected gear ratio's output to the chain drive.

parts.name: Gearshift Mechanism
parts.description: The shift spindle, shift drum and shift forks that move the gears when you work the shift lever.
parts.function: Each click of the shift lever rotates the shift drum by one position. Grooves in the drum guide the shift forks, which slide the gear dogs into or out of engagement.
parts.verificationNote: The Honda diagram names and part numbers are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.
